scope: M2-A immutable initial-input capture and isolated tool-free planner experiments; not all M2/M3

targeted.command: uv run pytest tests/test_decision_frames.py tests/test_decision_lab.py tests/test_t1_decider.py tests/test_trader_tools_wiring.py tests/test_sector_first_wiring.py tests/test_entry_pricing.py tests/test_model_factory.py tests/test_two_decisions.py -q --no-header

full_suite.warning_detail: Existing test_build_lock multithreaded multiprocessing fork deprecation warnings

source_verification.method: Compared every tested-files archive entry with the successful runner verified-files.json using both SHA-256 and Git blob SHA
source_verification.plan_handling: The tested active M2-A plan is replaced by a completed delivery record; this verification JSON is added separately

initial_validation.followup: Added dependency-lock identity, transaction rollback and one-shot capture guards, preserved large existing turn budgets, and explicitly incomplete usage on interrupted requests; six regression cases added

important_semantics.capture: Actual pre-provider SDK input, not a reconstructed world or full tool trajectory
important_semantics.state: Displayed book/knowledge/note, not a restorable complete account checkpoint
important_semantics.build: Planner source/template/dependency-lock identity, not all repository learning code
important_semantics.intervention: One exact unique knowledge fragment; non-knowledge input unchanged; parent hash retained
important_semantics.trials: Fresh subprocess and private storage per sample; one logical attempt; SDK transport retries and client failover disabled; no retry until buy
important_semantics.limits: Maximum 200 logical samples, four workers, explicit deadlines; schedule seed does not seed the model
important_semantics.usage: Counts only journaled requests; interrupted/unrecorded requests and token usage can be missing, never inferred zero-cost
important_semantics.tools: Tool-bearing initial-input captures are observation-only and refused by frozen-plan executor
important_semantics.source_reads: Read-only/query-only source export; no source account/order/learning writes in experiment
important_semantics.parser_check: Reusing a saved raw response is not an independent behavioral sample
important_semantics.model_identity: Configured declared model must match; provider-side routing or training knowledge is not certified

not_verified: User's original seven local runs and historical-journal import
Point-in-time truth or authenticity of original inputs
Continuous account and learning state branching
Full online/replay strategy convergence or scheduler isolation
M3 behavioral evolution, profitability, improved drawdown or out-of-sample alpha
